headline: Bitcoin holds near $78k amid consolidation, eyes key $78.8k resistance as liquidity dries
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming a descending channel, holding the 78.0k‑78.2k swing low while testing the 78.5k‑78.8k resistance zone; a break above would trigger a short‑term rally, but failure may push price back to the 77.5k support.
altcoin_summary: Altcoins are rotating into high‑beta assets; IOST and VTHO lead with >60% gains as capital seeks outsized upside while Bitcoin steadies.
strategy_outlook: Spot traders should buy on dips near $77.5k with a tight stop at $77.2k; futures players can sell‑stop‑loss at $78.8k to capture a potential short‑term pullback.
